summary: MoneySutra Admin Phase 2 Testing Complete - Event Tracking & Analytics. Backend: 17/17 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All admin pages load and function correctly. Engagement Intelligence and Feature Usage pages working with real data.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be child of <tbody>/<tr>/<th>/<td> - caused by .map() rendering wrapper spans. This is a cosmetic console warning and doesn't affect functionality.
Console warning: The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0. Chart renders correctly but throws console warning during initial load.

critical_code_review_comments: Event tracking endpoints (POST /api/events/track, POST /api/events/session) working correctly - accepting userId, sessionId, eventType, pageName
Engagement analytics (GET /api/admin/engagement) returns avgSessionToday, avgSession7d, avgSession30d, heatmap (7x24), dayOfWeekChart, peakHours
Feature usage (GET /api/admin/feature-usage) returns pageTable with page metrics, funnel data (Home->Wealth->Health->Goals->Expenses), totalSessions
All 6 admin nav tabs (Overview, User Growth, Engagement, Feature Usage, User Intelligence, Risk Radar) working correctly
Admin pages properly isolated from main app - no overlay blocking clicks
useEventTracker hook fires page_view events when navigating main app (verified through Feature Usage page data)
React hydration warnings in tables are cosmetic only (caused by .map() in tbody) - functionality unaffected

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All Phase 2 admin pages load and function correctly)

seed_data_creation: Test events created via /api/events/track and /api/events/session during testing - visible in Feature Usage page (admin, Home, Wealth, Health, Expenses pages tracked)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Phase 2 complete. Event tracking system working: POST /api/events/track and POST /api/events/session store events in user_events and user_sessions collections. Engagement analytics shows session duration metrics, 7x24 heatmap, day-of-week chart, peak hours. Feature Usage shows page-wise activity table with avg time, % users visited, total visits, repeat visits; also shows 5-stage activity funnel (Home->Wealth->Health->Goals->Expenses). All 6 admin nav tabs work. React hydration warnings are cosmetic.

event_tracking_track.details: POST /api/events/track accepts userId, sessionId, eventType, pageName and returns {ok: true}. Stores events with hour and dayOfWeek for heatmap.

event_tracking_session.details: POST /api/events/session with action=start/end/page works correctly. Creates session records, tracks page durations, calculates session duration on end.

engagement_analytics.details: GET /api/admin/engagement returns avgSessionToday=2s, avgSession7d=2s, avgSession30d=2s, totalSessions30d=2, totalEvents30d=24. Heatmap is 7x24 array. dayOfWeekChart has 7 entries (Mon-Sun). peakHours shows top 3 activity hours.

feature_usage.details: GET /api/admin/feature-usage returns pageTable with 5 entries (admin, Home, Wealth, Health, Expenses), funnel with 5 stages, totalTrackedUsers=2, totalSessions=4.

admin_login.details: POST /api/admin/login with admin@moneyssutra.com/admin123 returns success=true and sets admin_token cookie.

frontend_engagement_page.details: Engagement Intelligence page at /admin/engagement loads with 4 session stat cards, Peak Activity Hours, Time-of-Day Activity Heatmap (7x24), Day-of-Week bar chart.

frontend_feature_usage_page.details: Feature Usage page at /admin/features loads with summary cards (Pages Tracked, Total Sessions, Tracked Users), Page-wise Activity table, Activity Funnel (Home->Expenses stages).

admin_navigation.details: All 6 admin nav tabs (Overview, User Growth, Engagement, Feature Usage, User Intelligence, Risk Radar) navigate correctly. No overlay blocking clicks.

event_tracker_hook.details: useEventTracker hook fires page_view events - visible in Feature Usage page showing Home, Wealth, Health, Expenses pages tracked with visit counts.
